title: Charred Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty North African-inspired dish featuring charred lamb and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Tagine spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Season the lamb with salt and tagine spices.
Grill the lamb over direct heat for 5 minutes per side, or until nicely charred.
Transfer the lamb to a large Dutch oven or tagine.
Add olive oil, chopped onions, and lemon juice to the pot.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
